facilities.name: Life Care Center of Banner Elk

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.
Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.
Provide activities to meet all resident's needs.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to organize and participate in resident/family groups in the facility.

Try different approaches before using a bed rail.  If a bed rail is needed, the facility must (1) assess a resident for safety risk; (2) review these risks and benefits with the resident/representative; (3) get informed consent; and (4) Correctly install and maintain the bed rail.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Keep aisles, corridors, and exits free of obstruction in case of emergency.
Ensure smoke barriers are constructed to a 1 hour fire resistance rating.
Have properly installed electrical wiring and gas equipment.
Meet requirements for the installation and maintenance of electrical systems.
top_deficiency_types.category: Gas, Vacuum, and Electrical Systems Deficiencies
